name: fire-hydrant
description: A pillar fire hydrant: a cast barrel on a bolted ground flange with a raised nozzle section, two hose outlets at the sides and a larger pumper outlet facing +Z, each with a threaded neck, a lugged cap, a pentagon nut and a hanging cap chain, and a domed bonnet with flange bolts, a weather shield and a pentagon operating nut on top. The barrel colour and the bonnet and cap colour (the flow-class code) are separate options.

params.name: height
params.description: Height above the ground in metres (most pillar hydrants are 0.7-0.9).

params.name: radius
params.description: Radius of the barrel in metres.

params.name: outlets
params.description: 1 = only the pumper outlet at the front, 2 = two hose outlets at the sides, 3 = both hose outlets and the pumper.

params.name: colour
params.description: Barrel colour: 0 red, 1 yellow, 2 silver, 3 white.

params.name: topColour
params.description: Bonnet and cap colour: 0 red, 1 yellow, 2 silver, 3 white, 4 blue, 5 green, 6 orange (in the US the bonnet colour marks the flow class: blue, green, orange, red).

params.name: chains
params.description: Chains that keep the caps on the barrel.
